# RingSlot

> RingSlot provides one-time virtual phone number activations for legitimate SMS verification, privacy, authorized business workflows, and software testing. Availability varies by service, country, carrier, and upstream provider.

Canonical website: https://www.ringslot.shop/

## Primary pages

- [About](https://www.ringslot.shop/about): What RingSlot is and who it is for
- [Virtual phone number guide](https://www.ringslot.shop/virtual-phone-number): How to choose and request a one-time SMS activation
- [Services](https://www.ringslot.shop/services): Public service directory
- [Countries](https://www.ringslot.shop/countries): Public country directory
- [Pricing](https://www.ringslot.shop/pricing): Pricing model and activation information
- [API documentation](https://www.ringslot.shop/api-docs): Supported REST endpoints and authentication

## Verified product facts

- One-time activation numbers are offered; long-term rentals are not currently available.
- Configured catalog: dozens of services and 90+ selectable countries.
- Displayed starting price: $0.10; actual prices and inventory vary.
- Minimum wallet deposit: $20 USD equivalent.
- Eligible activations that remain without an SMS for the 10-minute activation window are automatically refunded to the RingSlot wallet.
- Cryptocurrency options are supplied by the connected payment processor and shown on the deposit screen.
- API authentication supports `X-API-Key` and authenticated web sessions use bearer tokens.
- RingSlot is not affiliated with third-party brands shown in its directory.

## Responsible-use boundary

Users must comply with law, RingSlot policies, and the rules of the third-party platform involved. Fraud, impersonation, spam, unauthorized access, ban evasion, and attempts to defeat safety controls are prohibited.

Support: support@ringslot.shop
